title: Investigating Deep Learning Approaches for Hate Speech Detection in Social Media
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of deep learning models (CNN, LSTM) for detecting hate speech and aggression in social media. While the classification categories include 'Racism' (targeting religious groups like Islam or Jews) and 'Sexism', the study evaluates the models' performance on classification tasks rather than investigating or benchmarking religious doctrine, ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning.
